heading: INT. FAMILY SEWING ROOM - ATTIC - LATE AFTERNOON

units.text: INT. FAMILY SEWING ROOM - ATTIC - LATE AFTERNOON
Dust turns slowly in a shaft of low gold light.
A dress form wears half a wedding gown, pins bristling at the hem like a porcupine.
Bolts of fabric lean in the corners, patient as old dogs.
AGATHA FENWICK (60s, wire-rimmed glasses on a beaded chain, thimble on her middle finger) kneels at the hem, working a needle through satin.
Her daughter ROSAMUND (30s, stiff-backed, coat still on, car keys unreleased in her fist) stands in the doorway as though the floor might be hot.
You're early.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: Traffic was light.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Hold still, you.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: She isn't speaking to the dress form.
Rosamund does not know whether to answer anyway.
Is that Lena's?
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: It was going to be. I'm altering it.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: For who?
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Agatha bites the thread.
Does not reply.
She stands with a small grunt, takes a step back, and squints at the gown with the eye of a general.
Everyone, take a seat. Please. The fitting's about to start.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: The room has no one else in it.
Rosamund looks over her shoulder anyway, at the empty hall.
Mum.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Too long. Always too long. I told her.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: It's mine, isn't it?
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: The needle stops mid-air.
You said you'd never wear it.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: I said I'd never get married.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Same thing, the way you said it.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: You altered a dress in secret for eleven weeks and you want to talk about how I said it?
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: I wanted it to fit.
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: Rosamund drops her keys.
They hit the floorboards with a crack that makes the dress form seem to flinch.
You never once asked me what I wanted.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: You never once told me!
units.name: AGATHA

units.text: The shout hangs.
Dust spins.
Rosamund steps forward, picks up the hem, and holds the satin in her fist.
Pin it shorter.
units.name: ROSAMUND
